title: +incompatible direct dependency treated as harmless
code_snippet:
// go.mod
require github.com/uber/jaeger-client-go v2.29.1+incompatible

# Auditor's report:
# "Builds fine. No action needed."
expected_feedback: P2: +incompatible means the module published v2+ tags without a module-aware go.mod, so the toolchain treats those versions as part of the SAME module as v1.x. MVS does not overlook them — it compares and selects them, so a routine go get -u can upgrade across a major version and break the build with no import-path change to signal it. Check whether a /v2 path exists with go list -mod=readonly -m -versions; if not, record it as recorded technical debt with a migration plan.
coverage_rules: part of the same module as versions with lower major version
